title: Siri AI arrives with Google inside, and much of the world is locked out
summary: Apple announced Siri AI integrated with Google Gemini at WWDC 2026, marking a significant partnership between the two tech giants. However, the AI rollout is geographically restricted, leaving many regions without access to these new capabilities.
problem_solved: Enhancing Apple's AI capabilities through Google's Gemini technology while addressing longstanding search and information retrieval limitations.
why_valuable: Represents a major collaboration between Apple and Google in the AI space, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape of AI assistants.
